title: Winter Patterns Cut and Paste

overview.description: Winter-themed pattern recognition activity using cut and paste. Child identifies the pattern (AB, ABB, ABC, etc.), cuts out the correct next piece, and pastes it in position. Combines: pattern recognition (math/logic) + scissor skills (fine motor) + sequencing (cognitive). Winter theme (snowflakes, mittens, etc.) makes it seasonal/engaging.

gaps.name: pattern-cut-and-paste
gaps.description: A themed pattern extension page: rows of patterns (AB, ABB, ABC, AABB) with a gap. Cut-out pieces at the bottom. Child identifies the pattern, cuts the correct piece, pastes it to complete the sequence. Combines math (patterns) + fine motor (cutting/pasting). Generatable for any theme.

notes: Link likely expired. Cross-curricular again: math patterns + fine motor (cutting/pasting) + seasonal theme (winter). The cut-and-paste mechanic appears in multiple Aless drops now (solar system ordering, this pattern extension). It is a consistent format preference.
